title: Read the First Meter
briefing: Place and Deep Scan the Power Meter to confirm the starter line can be measured before depot work begins.
fieldGuide: This keeps progression grounded in the first system rather than jumping to a full factory. The meter is a diagnostic reward, not a production unlock. The depot route remains a prototype handoff into Logistics Network.

objectives.label: Deep Scan the Power Meter
objectives.detail: Place the Power Meter on the starter line and scan it.

objectives.label: Read the depot request
objectives.detail: Review the depot request board guidance in Index or the Terminal archive panel.

rewards.label: Power Cell
rewards.detail: A modest component toward the next starter upgrade.

rewards.label: Insulated Wire
rewards.detail: A small wiring reward for safe follow-up routing.

metadata.completionFeedback: Depot request checked. Runtime Budget Review is available as an optional side check.
